scope: Cross-check the exact AC1021 inline-SAB to AC1024 SAT v1 output with a separately implemented SAT text parser, resolve torus range token meaning, preserve exact binary64 field values, and identify the remaining native-geometry gate.

independentParser.parserEntry: AcisReader.readText, then SurfaceTorus.set on the parsed torus-surface record
independentParser.isolation: The scratch harness stubs FreeCAD, Part and importer utility imports needed for module initialization. The parser and SurfaceTorus field decoder run from the pinned external Acis.py source. No Part shape construction or kernel operation is invoked.
limitations: This is parser and field decoding evidence only, not a native FreeCAD import or B-rep validity check.
InventorLoader constructs geometry through FreeCAD Part/OpenCASCADE and therefore does not provide an independent kernel oracle.
The repository documents unsupported blending surfaces, helix surfaces for lines, and some law-defined curves/surfaces.

initialDefect.initialTorusText: torus-surface ... forward_v F F F F F #
initialDefect.observed: InventorLoader read all 14 records and one body, but SurfaceTorus.set failed while decoding a range with ValueError: could not convert string to float: F.
initialDefect.cause: The SAB-to-SAT converter emitted every false torus-surface boolean as F, including four range-kind bits. InventorLoader's independent RANGE table maps a finite F range to a following numeric bound; false range-kind bits map to I.

implementation.precisionFix: SAT numeric formatting now uses std::numeric_limits<double>::max_digits10 with the classic locale; the prior six-significant-digit formatting rounded source binary64 values.
implementation.generatedControls: Fast token controls assert round-trip numeric lexemes for nontrivial coordinates/radii, along with forward/reverse sense, full-range I markers, and finite U-start output. A nonfinite resTol header scalar is confirmed by the SAB parser, then refused by SAT conversion with the caller output sentinel unchanged. A separate torus LocationVec NaN mutation is confirmed by SAB parsing, then refused by SAT conversion with the caller output sentinel unchanged. An extra torus-surface Boolean is parser-valid but rejected by the bounded SAT serializer, preserving the existing output sentinel.
implementation.exactNumericEquality: PASS: all center/axis/radius/U-origin numeric values decoded from source SAB equal the corresponding values parsed from emitted SAT text using Python binary64 equality.
implementation.limits: Parser/field decoding only; harness stubs FreeCAD and Part imports and invokes no shape construction or kernel operations.
implementation.allocationFailureBehavior: SAT text assembly is staged locally; drw_convertSabToSatV1 catches std::bad_alloc and other exceptions and returns false before swapping the caller output. The all-offset generated control verifies destination preservation and same-buffer retry.
